newsitem.title: USA: Rockford to manage Norland Capital.
newsitem.headline: Rockford to manage Norland Capital.

text.p: Norland Medical Systems Inc said on Wednesday it signed an agreement with Rockford Industries Inc for Rockford to underwrite and manage its new financing program.

Norland said in a statement Rockford would manage Norland Capital, a financing program for U.S. customers buying its bone densitometers. Rockford would administer various programs and assume all potential credit risks, Norland said.

"By providing attractive financing and leasing options to our customers through Norland Capital, we will speed up the buying cycles of our customers and increase sales penetration," Reynald Bonmati, Norland chairman and president said in a statement.
Specialty finance company Rockford said it had previously provided financing options to the bone densitometry market.
